page.overview:
What is Azelf?

Azelf is a greyish-blue, fairy-like Pokémon. It has two long tails encrusted with two red gems. Azelf has a blue face and another red gem on its forehead, it has a cone-shaped head with a large flat helmet extended on its head and yellow catlike eyes.

In Platinum, Azelf, Mesprit, and Uxie help guide you through the distortion world where you can capture Giratina. Azelf can than be battled in it's cavern.

The player, with Cogita's guidance and accompanied by Volo and either Adaman or Irida (depending on the player's choice), has to journey to the three lakes of Hisui to get the necessary materials to forge the Red Chain in order to stop "the Pokémon on the other side of the Rift". Azelf will be protected by a LV 58 Alpha Overqwil.

Azelf's test : "Show me your unyielding will. Strike me, if you can." A basket of Balms will appear. Azelf will than make the palyer attack it many times. The lake Guardian will reward the player with Azelf's Fang once it has been "defeated". Once all the "pieces of the spirit" are gathered, Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf will appear at the Shrouded Ruins and forge the Red Chain.
